labels.text: Section 55(d)(1)(A): the AMT exemption amount for a joint return or a surviving spouse. Statutory $78,750 (base year 2012, before the section 55(d)(3) indexing that starts after 2012); section 55(d)(4)(A)(i)(I) substitutes $109,400 for taxable years beginning after 2017 (2018 is the unindexed base of the section 55(d)(4)(B) adjustment). Indexed values are pinned only where the Revenue Procedure is pinned: 2025 (Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.11) and 2026 (Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.10). Years between the anchored rows are NOT pinned in this package (no Revenue Procedure text for them is in us.irc.inflation_adjustments): evaluation returns MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE there instead of a fabricated indexed figure (TECH-GAPS, income-individual stage 2 AMT).
section 55(d)(4)(A)(i)(I): substitute "$109,400" for "$78,750" (unindexed base year of (4)(B))
Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.11: joint returns or surviving spouses, 2025
Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.10: joint returns or surviving spouses, 2026
